harrat-mujtaba:1-1.t: «أولياء» is a second object; the clause «تلقون» is explicative of their befriending them; the clause «وقد كفروا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in «تُلْقون»; the clause «يخرجون» is explicative of their disbelief; «وإياكم» is a detached accusative pronoun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «الرسول»; the maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن تؤمنوا» is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); the clause «إن كنتم خرجتم» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, what precedes indicating it, i.e.: then do not take My enemy and your enemy as allies. «جهادا» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, i.e.: you strive (تجاهدون); the clause «تُسِرُّون» is resumptive; the clause «وأنا أعلم» is a ḥāl from the fāʿil (agent) of «تسرُّون»; the conditional clause is resumptive; the preposition phrase «منكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl from the fāʿil of «يفعله».

harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: The preposition phrase «لكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أعداء»; «لو» is maṣdariyya (infinitival), and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause «تكفرون» is the ṣila of the relative particle (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī).

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: «لا» is redundant (zāʾida), to emphasise the negation; «يوم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يفصل»; the preposition phrase «بما» is attached to «بصير».

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: The preposition phrase «لكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate); the preposition phrase «في إبراهيم» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «أسوة»; the adverb «معه» is attached to the ṣila (relative clause); «إذ» is an adverbial noun, a badal (substitute) of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) from «إبراهيم»; the preposition phrase «منكم» is attached to «برآء», and the preposition phrase «مما» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the first preposition phrase; the preposition phrase «من دون» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «ما»; the clause «كفرنا» is resumptive within the scope of the saying; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن تؤمنوا» is genitive by «حتى», attached to «بدا»; «وحده» is a ḥāl from the Divine Name, and it is definite but interpreted as indefinite; «قول» is a connected excepted [noun] from his words «في إبراهيم», on the assumption of an omitted muḍāf, its implied form being: in the sayings of Ibrāhīm, except his saying such-and-such. The clause «لأستغفرن» is the answer to an implied (muqaddar) oath, and the oath with its answer is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl) of Ibrāhīm's saying; the clause «وما أملك» is conjoined to the clause of the answer to the oath; «شيء» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «مِنْ» is redundant (zāʾida); the preposition phrase «لك» is attached to «أملك»; the preposition phrase «من الله» is attached to a ḥāl from «شيء»; the clause «ربنا» is resumptive within the scope of the saying; and the clause «عليك توكلنا», the answer to the vocative, is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: The clause «ربَّنا» is resumptive within the scope of the saying; the preposition phrase «للذين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «فتنة»; the clause «إنك أنت العزيز» is the answer to the last vocative; «أنت» is tawkīd (emphasis) of the kāf in «إنك».

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t: The preposition phrase «فيهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «أسوة»; the preposition phrase «لمن» is a badal (substitute) from «لكم»; the clause «ومن يَتَوَلَّ» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause of the answer to the oath, «لقد كان»; «هو» is the separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl).

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: «عسى» is incomplete (nāqiṣa), and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is the khabar (predicate); the adverb «بينكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied (muqaddar) second object. The preposition phrase «منهم» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the relative noun; the clause «والله قدير» is resumptive, and the clause «والله غفور» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «الله قدير».

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: The preposition phrase «في الدين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يقاتلوكم»; the maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن تبرُّوهم» is a badal (substitute) from «الذين» before it, a badal of inclusion (badal ishtimāl).

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن تولَّوهم» is a badal (substitute) of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) from «الذين» before it. The conditional clause is resumptive. «هم» is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: «الذين» is ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition); the conditional clause, the answer to the vocative, is resumptive; «إذا» is adverbial and conditional, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the meaning of the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); «مهاجرات» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «المؤمنات»; the clause (الله أعلم) is parenthetical; the preposition phrase «بإيمانهن» is attached to «أعلم»; the clause «فإنْ علمتموهن» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the conditional clause before it; «مؤمنات» is a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «لا هنَّ حلّ» is resumptive; «لا» is negative and inoperative (muhmala), and what follows it is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); «ما» is a relative noun, second mafʿūl bihi; the clause «ولا جناح عليكم» is conjoined to the clause «لا ترجعوهُنَّ»; the maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن تنكحوهن» is accusative by removal of the preposition (في); «إذا» is adverbial and conditional, attached to the meaning of the implied (muqaddar) apodosis, what precedes indicating it; «أجورهنَّ» is a second object; the clause «ولا تمسكوا» is conjoined to the clause «لا ترجعوهن»; the clause «ذلكم حكم» is resumptive; the clause «يحكم» is a ḥāl from «حكم», the linking element being implied, i.e.: by it (به); and the clause «والله عليم» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: The clause «وإن فاتكم شيء» is resumptive; the preposition phrase «من أزواجكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «فاتكم». The preposition phrase «إلى الكفار» is attached to «فات», which has been made to include the meaning of fleeing and going; the clause «فعاقبتم» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «فاتكم»; the clause «فآتوا» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); «مثل» is the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «آتُوا»; the preposition phrase «به» is attached to «مؤمنون».

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: The conditional clause is resumptive, the answer to the vocative; his words «يبايعنك»: an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn because it is attached to the nūn, and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «المؤمنات»; the maṣdar (verbal noun) made genitive by «على» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb «يبايعنك»; «شيئا» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause «يفترينه» is a naʿt (adjective) of «بهتان»; and the clause «فبايعهن» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).

harrat-mujtaba:13-13.t: The clause «لا تتولَّوا», the answer to the vocative, is resumptive; the clause «غضب» is a naʿt (adjective) of «قوما»; the clause «يئسوا» is a second naʿt of «قوما»; the kāf is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: a despair like the despair (يأسا مثل يأس); «ما» is maṣdariyya (infinitival), and the maṣdar (verbal noun) is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
